## Description

Get the owner's agreement on ADR-022: one .NET Conversations module with channel adapters, tenant resolution from verified channel identity, AI turns in the AI service with tools executed by Medvya, two support queues on one model, and central administration without patient data. Check Meta WhatsApp Cloud API facts on the official docs (webhook verification and X-Hub-Signature-256, Embedded Signup versus numbers under one business account, template categories and approval, message windows, pricing, data location) and record them in the ADR.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** ADR-022 is Accepted by the owner, or amended with the reason.
- [ ] **AC2.** The WhatsApp onboarding model per tenant is chosen with the Meta facts and their sources recorded.
- [ ] **AC3.** What needs a person (Meta business verification, template approval: MDV-P4-032) is listed in docs/05-delivery/session-handoff.md.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
